events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Bitter Alliance

options.text: We'll meet these [rival] and their traitorous minions on the field of battle.
We have no desire for war. Give in to their demands.

events.text: An advisor brings grave news. With assistance from the embittered [family] Family, [character] seeks to challenge our rule, which he now deems "baleful and corrupt." [character] demands our complete submission.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Challenge of Honor

options.text: This ends here!
I will not sully myself with this fight.
Agree. Nothing says that you have to fight fair...

events.text: [character] stops you on the road, ready for battle in full armor. Approaching your entourage, he speaks in a loud and unwavering voice. "I have come to challenge the murderer [character] to combat." He turns to address you directly, "I will not stoop to your dirty methods. You have a chance to die with honor. I will avenge the death of my father and ensure that no one else will have to suffer under this unjust rule!"

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Child

options.text: That glow of being at peace with the world was certainly short lived.

events.text: Pregnancy has no shortage of unpleasant side effects, but in this particular case, [character] smug I-told-you-so looks might be among the most aggravating issues.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Child

options.text: A healthy child, to produce cries so piercing as to keep half of [city] awake.

events.text: As [character] test predicted, you bear a child within months.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Child No More
events.text: [character] is growing into a strong-willed young man, and the day will come soon when he will expect to rule in his own right. It is apparent, now, the kind of king he would be.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Child No More
events.text: [character] is growing into a strong-willed young man, and the day will come soon when he will expect to rule in his own right. It is apparent, now, the kind of king he would be.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Clean Conscience
events.text: "I. Did. Warn. You." This, in [character] voice, is the last thing you hear before firm hands hold your face down in the waters of your own bath.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Dagger for a Dagger

options.text: You spot the flash of the blade and are able to move out of the way in time.
[character] reaches you, but you stay calm under attack and call for help.
The guards reach you too late, and [character] is hacked down as your own lifeless body hits the floor.

events.text: As warned, [character] makes an attempt on your life. Throwing caution to the wind one evening, he launches at you right in the middle of a party when the guards are distracted by a commotion outside. His sword flashes in the light of the oil lamp as he approaches. Is this the end?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Deal Is Struck

options.text: [character] certainly knows his way around politics.

events.text: [character] confidence was not misplaced, it seems. He returns triumphant from the diplomatic expedition to [tribe] lands with the full backing of [character].

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Deception Revealed

options.text: It cannot be known that [character] tolerates duplicity.
Sometimes, pride and wrath must be swallowed.

events.text: [character] was ordered, all those years ago, to see to it that newborn [character] would not live to enact his destiny of toppling [rival]. But it seems [character] did no such thing and merely gave [character] to the care of a peasant family. Your advisors reassure you that in his child's play [character] has already acted out his destiny and it need not come to pass in reality... that still, of course, leaves the matter of [character] betrayal.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Delicate Matter

options.text: We shall accept the offer of ransom.
[character] shall rot here until his pathetic death.
I sense [character] may have some reluctance to return the throne to [character].

events.text: Ever since you rashly captured [character], you have been waiting for the other shoe to drop. But [rival] has simply carried on, with [character] unofficially performing the duties of [character] while he is 'dealing with an international matter'. But, finally, a messenger from [character] arrives in [city], feeling out terms of negotiation.

events.author: Solver
events.name: A Failed Gamble

options.text: Let them settle in [city] permanently then, whether they want to or not.
If they could make the pilgrimage, they can certainly do labor.
This was embarrassing. Send them back to [rival] anyway.

events.text: Our plan to hold the [rival] pilgrims hostage has proven futile. The envoys we sent to [rival] returned, only to report that nobody is particularly concerned with the fate of the hostages. Instead of leverage, it seems we have only gained mouths to feed.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Favorable Outcome

options.text: This is good news for everyone.

events.text: The [tribe] match is intelligent, wise, and quite pleasing to the eye. [character] should be satisfied with our judgment.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Few Nights More

options.text: Allow the child to stay at the palace and grow up as a royal.
Give the child to a lesser noble family where they will never be found.

events.text: What started as some harmless fun has turned into something more. Rather than returning with the caravan to [rival], [character] stayed hidden in the palace for a week, meeting with [character] at every opportunity before eventually returning home. Now a message has arrived, saying that the foreign heir is pregnant. [character] is afraid for the child's safety in [rival], leaving the choice to you and [character] as to what to do with the child. Time is short, whispers and rumors will soon be spreading across [rival].

events.author: Solver
events.name: A Fiery End

options.text: Send assistance for [city] to repair the damage.
The city's government failed. It should be reorganized.
The guard in [city] failed - conduct additional guard training in our cities.

events.text: The killer who claimed several lives in [city] is no more. Sadly, even his final moments were some of the city's worst. The city guard had managed to track the killer down. He had been living out of an abandoned workshop, where he rested during the day while prowling the city at night. As the guards moved to capture the killer, he set fire to some tar barrels. A huge fire swept through several streets before finally stopping. It claimed the lives of at least three guards, and the surviving witnesses report that the killer was laughing madly even as the flames engulfed his hideout. The threat to [city] is now gone, but at what cost?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Frustrating Outcome

options.text: Forbid [character] access to the royal treasury.
I am increasingly frustrated with him.

events.text: Our agents in the court have been trying to convince [character] to cease his rampant spending, but to no avail. Feasts. Fineries. Jewels. Art. Exotic animals. Messengers bring new bills every day. Action is needed.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Funny Feeling

options.text: I must have the finest treatments available.
Bring my family. I do not want to be alone.
Death does not frighten me.

events.text: It has been a long time since you caught young [character] testing poisons in his chambers. In fact, you had almost forgotten. Until you began suffering from stomach pains and a cold sweat that keeps you up at night. You try to convince yourself it is all in your mind. But then the bleeding begins...

events.author: Solver
events.name: A Game at Dinner

options.text: So be it. This ends tonight, one way or the other.
I would be foolish to walk into her trap. I must decline the invitation.

events.text: You and [character] have been invited to dinner tonight by [character]. Such invitations are never pleasant, as [character] always uses them as an opportunity to influence your husband and to undermine you, not even making an effort to hide her hatred for you and her disdain for [character]. This time, [character] wants to do more than play her usual mind games. You have been warned that she intends to play a rather deadlier game and poison you at the dinner. It seems [character] has decided that your rivalry is to end now, on her terms.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Hand Withdrawn

options.text: Oh well, there’s other fish in the trees.

events.text: As suitors come and go, each failing the task set, [character] has become increasingly resigned that there is no chance of his marrying.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Hero Appears

options.text: And so they will be married!
I changed my mind.

events.text: As expected, your plan worked! Despite the number of suitors who failed your arduous task, there is one hero, [character], who has succeeded. [character] is now expecting to wed [character] as promised. Shall the wedding bells ring?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Pale Horse

options.text: Beg for [character]'s forgiveness.
I will not accept the blame for his fate.

events.text: A rider on a pale horse arrives in the capital, and death follows with him. He delivers the news of [character]'s terrible demise. In a somber tone he recounts the painful and undignified death of the [rival] heir in all its gruesome detail. [character] is furious with you. With our aid, [character] may have survived his ordeal. Alas, we gave none, and now [character] is dead.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Parting

options.text: I am grateful for our years together.
He taught me courage in the face of fear.
Just a dog. A good dog, but just a dog.

events.text: Years have passed since you first rescued your devoted canine friend from his desperate fate. Your mercy has been rewarded tenfold. Now, as the old dog breathes his last, you reflect on his gift of companionship. And then he is gone...

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: A Peaceful Plea

options.text: Accept the Tribute.
Reject the Tribute and declare War.

events.text: An emissary arrives from [rival]. "The rumors you have heard are false. We hold no designs on your lands. Please accept this tribute as a show of our respect."

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Piercing Insight

options.text: Argh!

events.text: Walking through the palace gardens, you are extremely surprised by a dagger-wielding assassin leaping out at you from your favorite shrubbery. Fortunately, one of your guardsmen reacts instantly, skewering the would-be assassin with his spear before he can stab you! Unfortunately, the razor-sharp spear passes entirely through your assailant and pierces your thigh rather deeply.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Private Audience

options.text: Add [character] to the court.
We must investigate him first.

events.text: You meet with the supposed bloodline relative, a man named [character]. He explains that his mother shared a tryst with your father years ago, making him your half brother. [character] insists that his claim to the throne, while tainted, merits recognition.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: A Promise of a Match

options.text: Sometimes, sacrifices must be made.
This match is unacceptable.

events.text: The [tribe] match is quite unfortunate, but this is the best they have to offer. [character] will not look favorably on our decision. What shall we do?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Quiet Year

options.text: We shall put this cooperation to good use.

events.text: The houses of [family] and [family] have prospered of late, pooling investments and holding back from the usual squabbles and legal challenges. Such unexpected quiet has increased tax revenue and freed administrative resources for new initiatives.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: A Reckless Year

options.text: Never shall I stray again.

events.text: Your instincts to fear the heavens have proved all too prescient, as all you worked towards seems on the verge of collapse.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: A Second Opinion

options.text: [character] cannot be trusted.
I must seek [character]'s counsel.

events.text: [character]'s sickness keeps him confined to bed for days on end, and his condition does not appear to be improving. Some of your intimates in court suggest that you seek the opinion of great scientist [character].

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Sharp Reprimand

options.text: Argh!

events.text: During the night an assassin breaks into your palace. The guards spot him, but he is able to outrun your exhausted men, who are still recovering from the harsh training regime you recently implemented. Luckily, the assassin must have stolen a locally made weapon, as the blade which has just been thrust into your chest shatters against a rib instead of piercing your heart. Passing out from pain and shock, you can hear winded royal guards piling onto the would-be assassin.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: A Time to Dye

options.text: I have made a terrible mistake. Execute the rogue.
Time to subject this hair dye to rigorous scientific analysis.

events.text: Customers of [character] are complaining of headaches, miscarriages, seizures, the very conditions his hair dye is meant to be preventing. Some have died an agonising death like [character].

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Time to Kill: Consequences

options.text: Most unfortunate.

events.text: Disastrous news! [character] has discovered we were behind the death of his predecessor. Needless to say, he is extremely upset and has sworn vengeance against us.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Time to Kill: Consequences

options.text: Most unfortunate.

events.text: Disastrous news! Despite our best efforts, [character] has discovered we were behind the death of his predecessor. Needless to say, he is extremely upset and has sworn vengeance against us.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: A Time to Kill: Results!

options.text: I’m sure it will be fine.

events.text: News has arrived from [city], [character] is dead! Our assassin. Now, as long as our involvement is not discovered, our problems with [nation] should be over!

options.text: I’m sure it will be fine.

events.text: News has arrived from [city], [character] is dead! Our assassin. Now, as long as our involvement is not discovered, our problems with [nation] should be over!

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A Whole New World

options.text: Enjoy your travels!
It's time to come back.

events.text: A surprising message arrives. [character] and [character] have been traveling the world during their elopement. But while [character] is eager to continue adventuring, it seems that [character] is tired of a life on the road and wants to take his place at court. The message from [character] offers to inform you of their location if you will send people to collect them.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: A [religion] Council

options.text: To work!

events.text: Your new council is assembled, united by their [religion] faith and their desire to serve [rival]. Your dedication in creating a council of the State Religion has sent a clear message of your devotion and strength. [character], [character] and [character] stand as you enter the room. There is much to be done.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Abducted Heir

options.text: Declare war on [rival] to retrieve the heir.
We are in no position to fight [rival].
Continue to pursue diplomacy to save [character].

events.text: Allies from [rival] arrive with information about the traitor, [character], and the kidnapped heir. According to their spies, the former tutor and his charge are being harbored by the royal family of [rival]. The abduction plot was devised by the [rival] court in an attempt to weaken us. We must proceed carefully. The lives of the nation and the heir, [character], could hang in the balance.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Absolute Power Couple

options.text: We shall shape [rival] into a nation unequaled.

events.text: Though you had your reservations, it is becoming clear that the marriage of your authority with [character] popularity is creating a political powerhouse. Though the cheering in the streets has, perhaps, died down, there is little hint of dissent to a flurry of royal decrees.

events.name: Acropolis Guard

options.text: Consider it done.
Special guards are not necessary.

events.text: The [family] family offers to train an elite guard unit to protect their treasury inside the Acropolis. Of course, they are only willing to invest in this idea if the court shares some of the costs. What shall we tell them?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: After the Death

options.text: Erect a memorial in the capital [city].
Hold triumphal celebrations in [city] and [city].
Write a heroic, narrative account.

events.text: After several difficult years of sacrifice and death, the mysterious pockmark sickness appears to be receding. Sadly, many [rival] perished in this dark time. How shall we mark this moment for the generations to come?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Age of Unrest

options.text: Make a gift of food to the people, promising stability in these rough times.
Double down on the construction of monuments, ensuring your name lasts forever.
Personally reach out to these new rulers to establish contact between your courts.

events.text: The times are changing. News comes from abroad that Kings and Queens are falling one by one, a new generation rising to power in their place. This new generation is led by [title] [character], [title] [character], and [title] [character]. It remains to be seen in which direction they will steer their nations. It is up to you to reassure your nation in this time of upheaval. What message will you send from the throne of [rival]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Escapes

options.text: Well done!

events.text: [character] managed to retrieve the scrolls! In a stroke of cunning, he changed the meeting location to the site of a large religious gathering taking place in [city]. The informant handed over the secrets, and [character] blended back into the crowd, ready to deliver the scrolls and adopt a new identity. His position in [city] is safe.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Agent Exposed

options.text: The court will mourn his sacrifice…

events.text: The body of [character] has been subtly returned to [rival]. Your network of agents in [city] report that despite a ruse to lose them in a crowd, the [rival] guards managed to track down and kill both [character] and the informant before they could escape. Fortunately our role in this is still unknown, but the loss of [character] is a serious blow to [rival].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Akhenaten

options.text: Yes, I will now be known as Akhenaten.
No, I shall remain [character].

events.text: As the child of Aten, it falls to you to execute the divine god's will. One day it occurs to you that you could change your name to show your devotion to Aten, and to clearly show your relation to the divine.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: All Good Things

options.text: That is most unfortunate.

events.text: We have been unable to sustain good relations with the [tribe], and as such they have elected to end our Peace agreement.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Ambitious

options.text: It is acceptable to share our plans with the [tribe].
Ignore the savage wretch. He has no dominion here.
Assure [character] that we have no ill intentions.

events.text: Our recent preparations appear to have provoked [character], as a message from the [tribe] chief arrives soon after we have chosen our Ambition. "My warriors report much activity near [rival]. As ruler of these lands, it is my right to know of your designs. We wish to avoid further misunderstandings." The court is of a mind to teach [character] a lesson he will not soon forget, but that may not be the wisest course of action.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: An Exodus

options.text: Let them go, and good riddance.
Extend an olive branch on my behalf.
Poison the wine of their acolytes.

events.text: Our imprisonment of [character] was the final act of betrayal. The [family] are out of patience. Collecting their Family members and followers, many of the [family] have chosen to leave the nation and resettle elsewhere.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: An Uneasy Quiet
events.text: The hand of [character] in [rival] is dead. The court braces for word from [rival]. An accusation? A new appointment? But no, only routine communication about logistics and trade agreements, now handled by [character] former assistants.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: An Unexpected Visit

options.text: A struggle ensues!

events.text: As you relax alone one evening, [character] suddenly bursts into the room wielding a massive axe! “Why won’t you just die?!” he screams as he swings it at you with a crazed look in his eyes.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack!

options.text: Try to dodge!

events.text: As you make your way along a corridor you notice a bizarre-looking man arrive at the other end and start walking towards you. He appears to be holding large bellows of some sort, is wearing a heavy leather apron, and has a large pot strapped to his back. Before you can consider this further the man raises his bellows and, with a firm pump, sends a jet of liquid flame spurting right at you!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack!

options.text: Attempt to flee!

events.text: Strolling through a beautiful garden, one moment everything is peaceful, the next a mob of knife-wielding maniacs is charging at you from all sides! Your guards fall in a flurry of stabbing, hardly slowing your attackers at all.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack!

options.text: A struggle ensues!

events.text: You stand on a high balcony, admiring the view you have over [city], when suddenly you feel a rough hand against your back!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack!

options.text: What the?!

events.text: You are enjoying a relaxing riverside stroll when a sudden violent shove sends you plunging into the rapidly-flowing water below.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack!

options.text: I try to dodge!

events.text: Strolling by a tall tower you hear a faint scraping sound above. Curious, you look up and see a massive block of stone falling towards you!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack!

options.text: What the?!

events.text: Making your way through a recently renovated corridor you suddenly feel a slight movement under your foot and hear a faint click. To your horror, the floor suddenly drops away beneath and you start to fall!

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Another Attack!

options.text: Attempt to shoot the lead wolf!

events.text: You wait in ambush, holding your bow, for the beaters to drive a deer into range. Unexpectedly, a deep growl comes from behind and you spin around in shock to see a pack of wolves emerging from the undergrowth, fangs bared.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Apprehended Thief

options.text: Execute him in a public spectacle.
Demand an apology and release him.

events.text: Our spies have apprehended the thief who stole the ancient statue in [city]. Local leaders are calling for blood. What shall we do?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Archon Rising

options.text: Abdicate and accept your fate.

requirements.label: Tactician / Swift
tip: The leader must have one of: Tactician; Swift

options.text: Order the court guards to expel [character].
I will slay the traitor [character] myself!

events.text: [character] strides into court with an air of confidence. Flanked by two guards from his personal retinue, he points at you and shouts. "Seize the false ruler [character], for he is an impostor!" [character] has finally made his bid to seize the throne. What will you do?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: As Good as Their Word

options.text: This could only ever end in war.

events.text: [character] is gone, leaving only a simple note. The note details that, having again been denied his promised authority, he would be returning to [rival] and there recommending immediate military action to [character].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Assassination Revenge

options.text: Take anything but my life.
Do it, but I will haunt your dreams.

events.text: Armed men burst into your chambers and prepare to strike! It seems that [character] has been secretly plotting revenge for your failed assassination attempt. Your life hangs by a thread... What do you tell these would-be assassins?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Assassination of Monarch

options.text: Throw them in the hole we dug in the courtyard.
Reject their threats and avenge the dead king.
Stall them while we think of other options.

events.text: The [rival] escort is here for the pre-wedding feast we promised. The men are guarded and eager to return home. What shall we do with them?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Assassination of Monarch

options.text: Ready the baths. Then lock the doors and set it all on fire.
Reject their threats and avenge the dead king.

events.text: The [rival] have sent more men to bring [character] back for marriage, unaware of the fate of their fellow [rival].

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Assassination of Monarch

options.text: Very well, we will prepare a feast for their men.
Reject their threats and avenge the dead king.

events.text: The [rival] have returned and maintain their demand that [character] marry their ruler, [character]. They have sent 20 of their finest men as an armed escort. Otherwise, they will invade us and kill the new king!

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Assassination of Monarch

options.text: Throw them in the hole we dug in the courtyard.
Reject their threats and avenge the dead king.

events.text: The [rival] have returned and demand an answer. There is to be a wedding, or they will sack our nation and kill our ruler. What shall we do?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Assassins Called Off

options.text: My heir will live to see another day.

events.text: [character] has called off his assassins in light of your refusal to accept the bribe, scared of your retaliation if the plan went ahead. You just saved a life.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Attacked By a Bear

options.text: Express a desire to cooperate in the future.
Offer to set up trade between our two Nations.

events.text: The victims of the bear attack are delivered safely to a settlement of their nation, [rival]. The village leader thanks our people for their kindness.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Attacked By a Bear

options.text: Express a desire to cooperate in the future.
Offer to set up trade between our two Nations.

events.text: The victims of the bear attack are delivered safely to a settlement of their nation, [rival]. The village leader thanks our people for their kindness.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Attacked By a Bear

options.text: The world is full of dangers.

events.text: Months pass, and there is no sign of the guide you dispatched to escort the [rival] survivors of a bear attack.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Attacked By a Bear

options.text: Perhaps we can cooperate with [rival].

events.text: The leaders of [rival] have reached out to us. They appreciate that we notified them of the bear attack against their citizens, and they hope to continue good relations.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Autonomous Liberties

options.text: Very well. I trust [character]’s judgment.
[character] is taking advantage of his position. This experiment must end.
I will work with my friend [character] to find the funds elsewhere in [city]’s budget.

events.text: [city] has been enjoying Autonomous Rule, with [character] governing the city as he sees fit. Most recently he commissioned two small expeditions to explore the land beyond [city]’s borders. Citing reasons of national security and resource exploration, [character] is now asking for funds from the capital to recoup the project’s expenses.

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Bad News

options.text: We must proceed with war planning.
Muster troops at once.
[character] owes me a favor...

events.text: Alarming news from our agents in [rival]; the [rival] leadership has sent a request to [rival] for assistance in its war against us!

events.author: Soren Johnson
events.name: Bad News

options.text: Our military has been preparing for this moment.
Bring our finest units to the front.
I will meet with the [tribe] myself and dissuade them.

events.text: Spies in several [rival] cities have gained possession of highly sensitive military plans, including a proposed agreement between [rival] and the [tribe]. The agreement outlines an alliance against us, with the two factions splitting [rival] after our defeat. We cannot allow the formation of such a partnership.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Baseless Accusations

options.text: Retract the statements and apologize for slander.
Claim that a conspiracy has not been proven... yet.
Make a case for our suspicions.

events.text: Months have passed since your accusation of plotting between [character] and the [family] family, and... it appears to be baseless. This public mistake has not gone unnoticed. You must make amends by withdrawing the controversial charge. Or you can refuse and risk the wrath of the court.

events.author: Velociryx
events.name: Battle Chickens

options.text: Sweet Success! --But too bad about those Battle Chickens.

events.text: The research project is complete, and largely successful. Your military is now better prepared, thanks to augmentation by owls used selectively as spotters, ravens as messengers, and dogs with barding accompanying selected skirmisher units. Naturally, there were a few wrong turns, but that is to be expected any time one ventures into new territory. The "Great Battle Chicken Experiment," for example, was particularly tragic but at least the soldiers in the field ate well that week. In any case, this has to be regarded as a success!

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Behind the Throne

options.text: Conspiracy and temptation whisper Behind The Throne.

events.text: The crown rests uneasily. Nobles plot in their protected Estates, the disaffected gather ominously throughout the nation's Slums, and all the while Grand Vizier promise prosperity if you will but trust their governance of [rival] cities. It is said trust is for fools, yet paranoia is for tyrants. But Foolish or Paranoid, Mental Strain will set in all the same. Blackmail, betray, Gamble, Revel... or set an example of righteous behavior for all, no matter the cost.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Bellum Octavianum

options.text: To arms! We must rid ourselves of this threat once and for all!
The city must not fall to violence. Agree to allow [character] to return from his exile.

events.text: Chaos has gripped the heart of [rival]. What started as a quarrel between [character] and [character] over support for the exiled [character] has escalated into all-out violence. A fight in the forum led to [character] ally [character] being ejected from the city, where he has started gathering allies for a siege of [city]. The people are divided. Will you hold onto your title by force?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Betrothal

options.text: It is time for [character] and [character] to do their duty.
No, the deal is off.

events.text: With their approach to adulthood, [character] and [character] can finally be wed. Will the predetermined match still take place?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Betrothal

options.text: A tragic loss...

events.text: With the death of [character], the betrothal has been called off. [character] is free to do as he pleases.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Birthright

options.text: Surrender the throne to [character].
Let him and his followers come!
My people will never fight for [character].

events.text: Years of bitterness and envy come to fruition, as your brother [character] confronts you over the rules of succession. He believes that it is a mistake that you ever became [title] and that the throne is his by birthright. [character] claims that your rule has been a failure and threatens that his followers will rise up unless you step down.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Blindsided

options.text: Reinforce the city guard at once!
The most important thing is for government projects to continue.
I will give a speech in [city] to rally the people.

events.text: Many precautions were taken in [city] while looking for the bathhouse killer. The [family] and [family] nobles have been particularly careful, but almost everyone in the city has had the murders on their mind. With great sadness, the chief of the [city] guard admits the precautions failed. Governor [character] was attacked and strangled to death by an unknown assailant. Guards were assigned to him but heard the struggle too late to save [character]. The one bit of good news is that the guards now have a fair idea of what the killer looks like. The chief of the guard solemnly promises that this man, who has now committed three murders in [city], will soon be caught.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Blowback

options.text: I'm glad he knows. Perhaps the new king will treat us with more respect than his predecessor.
Send a mission to congratulate the new king.
Compose a personal letter explaining your actions.

events.text: Our assassins have returned from [rival] with a welcome report. [character] is no more... Unfortunately, the new [rival] King, [character], has discovered the true cause of [character]'s death. We must get ahead of this situation to prevent it from growing into future hostilities.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Brawls In [city]

options.text: This was a mistake. [city] needs to be compensated for the damage.
I have seen animals behave better than that. No matter, there's still a war to fight.
Kill all those "pilgrims" and take whatever they had on them.

events.text: The [religion] pilgrimage in [city] has not gone well. The pilgrims were met by angry residents who shouted that [rival] are not welcome in [city], and the shouting match soon devolved into street brawls. Some of the pilgrims and a few were beaten. The city guard broke the fight up, only to later catch a [rival] man trying to set a local tavern on fire.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Buddhist Dissent

options.text: Prepare the guards for any unrest.
Seek to appease the local [religion] leaders.
Take no action, for now.

events.text: [religion] discontent has spilled onto the streets of [city]. Unhappy with your rule, the local are leading the faithful in attacks on the guards and encouraging resistance against the crown.

events.author: Jeri Roys

followsFrom.name: In the Eyes of the Law

events.name: Business Interests

options.text: I suppose the matter rests, then.
She makes a mockery of our laws. See that they are changed and the case brought again.

events.text: The legal proceedings against [character] are almost immediately derailed by an unexpected turn. She has officially registered as courtesan, making any of her relationships legitimate business of her profession, a profession exempt from adultery laws. Pressure from the [family] now mounts as the case risks being a royal embarrassment.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Call of Thanatos

options.text: I am ready to cross the Styx.

events.text: You are still a young man in body and mind. A little slower than a decade ago, perhaps, but you are still confident you would defeat any of today's agoge students in one on one combat. You should have many more years and victories ahead of you, yet you know with absolute certainty that Thanatos is calling for you and it is time to get your affairs in order as these are your last days in the mortal world. There is no bargaining with the gods, nor would you wish to. Young [character] has grown and is no longer the child you fondly remember. Now it will be his turn to be king and you can count on him to continue your legacy and guide your nation to greatness.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Call of Thanatos

options.text: I am ready to cross the Styx.

events.text: You are still a young man in body and mind. A little slower than a decade ago, perhaps, but you are still confident you would defeat any of today's agoge students in one on one combat. You should have many more years and victories ahead of you, yet you know with absolute certainty that Thanatos is calling for you and it is time to get your affairs in order as these are your last days in the mortal world. There is no bargaining with the gods, nor would you wish to. The only unease you feel is the knowledge that [character] is still too young to be king and so his accession to the throne may cause a crisis. But you know that your people are the most resilient ones on earth and will persevere.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Captives of Belief

options.text: Free them, they have suffered long enough.
Keep them locked up, away from our people.

events.text: It has come to our attention that jails are packed with [tribe] captives. These pitiful souls were caught during a previous campaign led by the [family], but because of their exotic beliefs they have been left to languish. Releasing the captives would show tolerance, but it may be seen as lenience by nobles and priests.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Caught Red Handed

options.text: The city guard deserves praise. In the future, they should be even more capable.
Celebrate this as a success of local governance.
My foresight is to be credited for the killer's capture.

events.text: As the city guard in [city] search for the killer of the two nobles in the cold baths, the situation in the city is tense. Of all the people who experienced unpleasant moments, none had a bigger scare than Governor [character]. After dusk, [character] heard some shuffling steps and, before he knew who was coming, [character] found himself pinned to the ground by an attacker. The strange man ranted nonsensically as he tried to strangle [character], and then the precautions taken in [city] paid off. Guardsmen assigned to the Governor heard the scuffle and came running. The attacker was apprehended before [character] could suffer any serious injuries and confessed to the bath murders before [character] could gather his breath. [city] can breathe a sigh of relief. What lessons shall we learn from this?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Changing Tides

options.text: Argue for forgiveness.
Execute the priests of the temple.
Seek to enshrine [religion]'s rights.

events.text: [religion] is now the State Religion of [rival], but its followers have not forgotten the persecutions encouraged by Oracle of [city]. Now in a position of power, the demand that you punish the priests of for the harm they caused the followers of.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Changing Winds
events.text: With the breakdown of formal Alliance Player, [character] wastes no time in decamping for [rival]. Along with personal belongings and a few assistants, [character] takes with him a no doubt intimate knowledge of [rival] assets and defenses.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Child of Passion

options.text: I can see the resemblance.

events.text: After disappearing for months, your beautiful hunting companion has requested a private audience. She presents you with a child born of your passionate affair. You agree to let her raise the baby at court as your own, but outside of the royal line. She smiles, pleased with the outcome.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Childhood Friends

options.text: Wonderful news!

events.text: Your son [character] and the visiting [family] child, [character], have become close friends since the latter came to stay at your court. They are frequently seen playing together with the other royal children, and [character] has become especially good at making sure everyone gets along. Let us hope that childhood friendships such as these will improve [character] capacity for diplomacy as an adult.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Christian Dissent

options.text: Prepare the guards for any unrest.
Seek to appease the local [religion] leaders.
Take no action, for now.

events.text: [religion] discontent has spilled onto the streets of [city], Unhappy with your rule, the local are leading the faithful in attacks on the guards and encouraging resistance against the crown.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Clearcut Issue

options.text: Close the gates of [city].
Open the gates of [city] for the [tribe].

events.text: The [tribe] have not forgotten the desolation of their sacred spaces in the forests of [city]. Now, warriors have been armed, lines drawn. All that remains is a simple ultimatum: accept an honor guard of [tribe] warriors in [city] with the power of law, or face those warriors in battle.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Comeuppance

options.text: How could this have happened?

events.text: [character] has discovered your lies and is absolutely furious! All your attempts to wriggle out of this situation have failed, and he is now plotting vengeance against you.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Conflict in [city]

options.text: [character] will make a better governor.
Send your forces to support [character] and reduce the unrest.
Refuse to interfere in local politics.

events.text: The death of a in [city] has led to a violent power struggle, with the replacement [character] winning the title after three days of mobs fighting in the streets. One of the new's supporters was arrested by [character] for disturbing the peace and now the two city leaders are caught in a rapidly escalating conflict. News reaches you that [character] has been attacked by a, struck in the head with a rock while attempting to quell the religious rioting. The governor was only saved by the help of the city’s citizens and has now turned to [character] for advice, hoping the wise philosopher has the answers to stop this conflict.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Conscripts Resettled

options.text: These people have served their time.
We would rather fight than anger free people.

events.text: The conscripts released from the prisons of [city] have served their time. As some become too old to fight and others become wounded, the question has arisen of what should happen to those who can no longer serve. The troops request that they be given land to settle in [city] and retire as befits military veterans, while [character] suggests that they be sent to serve the remainder of their time in jail. It would avoid angering [city], but would likely lead to an uprising of disgruntled conscripts.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Conspiracy

options.text: Would he really betray us?

events.text: Worrisome rumors reach the court. They concern the popular hero, [character], and a claim that he is forming a plot to remove you from power. What shall we do?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Crossing the Rubicon

options.text: The die has been cast.

events.text: Your detractors in [city] have grown wary of your ever-growing popularity and the unwavering loyalty of your armies. Imperium, the right of military command, is granted by the people, and they now demand that you immediately disband your armies and return to [city]. Standing down is not an option. As your loyal commanders promise to stand by you, no matter what, you prepare to march on the city and openly defy the rules of Rome to assume command for life.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Curious Artifact

options.text: Return it at once.
We shall not be swayed by superstition.

events.text: A series of accidental deaths have the court in an uproar. Many blame the artifact that our soldiers looted from [tribe] settlement. They believe it is cursed and must be returned!

events.author: Solver
events.name: Darkest Hour

options.text: Reinforce the city guard at once!
The most important thing is for government projects to continue.
I will give a speech in [city] to rally the people.

events.text: This is a very dark time for [city]. The two deaths in the city's baths have shaken the city, and there have even been reports of brawls between [family] and [family], who have conducted themselves in a matter most unbecoming of nobles. Yet the worst was to come. Early this morning, Governor [character] was discovered dead in his chambers at the city hall. The stab wounds and overturned furniture leave no doubt that this was a murder. The only good news is that the city guards have obtained a description of a strange man who behaved erratically in the government quarter. The killer of [city] will surely not be able to evade capture much longer.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Dead End

options.text: We must be more careful whom we trust.
Improve palace security to prevent future incidents.

events.text: It is a tragic day for [rival]. The heir to the throne, [character], has been discovered in an abandoned [rival] encampment. His body shows marks of imprisonment and torture. [character], the traitorous tutor, is nowhere to be found. Wails of mourning are heard across the nation...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Deadly Heirs

options.text: I should have killed them when I had the chance.

events.text: Late one evening, you return to your chambers to find the body of [character], covered in blood. Shadows emerge from the corners of room. "The throne should have been ours," says an icy voice. The last people you see are [character] and [character], standing over you with daggers...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Deadly Heirs

options.text: I should have killed them when I had the chance.

events.text: Late one evening, as you drift off to sleep, you spot shadows in the corners of your chamber. "This throne should have been ours," says an icy voice. The last people you see are [character] and [character], standing over your bed with daggers...

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Dealing with Dissent

options.text: Outlaw the [religion] religion from [rival].
Send in your forces to crack down on [city].
Seek a diplomatic resolution.

events.text: Unrest rules the streets of [city] as the [religion] dissent continues unchecked. The [religion] [character] comes before the court to argue that the harshest measures should be taken with the rebellious religion. What will you decree?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Dealing with Dissent

options.text: Outlaw the [religion] religion from [rival].
Send in your forces to crack down on [city].
Seek a diplomatic resolution.

events.text: Unrest rules the streets of [city] as the [religion] dissent continues unchecked. The [religion] [character] comes before the court to argue that the harshest measures should be taken with the rebellious religion. What will you decree?

events.name: Dealing with Dissent

Send in your forces to crack down on [city].
Seek a diplomatic resolution.

events.name: Dealing with Dissent

options.text: Outlaw the [religion] religion from [rival].
Send in your forces to crack down on [city].
Seek a diplomatic resolution.

events.text: Unrest rules the streets of [city] as the [religion] dissent continues unchecked. The [religion] [character] comes before the court to argue that the harshest measures should be taken with the rebellious religion. What will you decree?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Death Stalks the Palace

options.text: Take [character] as a husband.
"Guards, kill this madman!"

events.text: It is a sad day; your husband never woke from his rest this morning. [character] consoles you. He has been a constant confidant during these troubled times and kept you focused on the tasks at hand and the running of the nation. [character] comes to you in your chambers and tells you that his investigation into the water poisonings is complete, “It’s simple, it was me. All I want is to be close to you. Can’t you see that I have been a better companion for you than [character] ever was?”

events.author: Jeri Roys

followsFrom.name: In the Eyes of the Law

events.name: Decency Prevails

options.text: She left me no choice, really.

events.text: [character] is found guilty of adultery and her time as head of the [family] is at an end.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Defeat!

options.text: I immediately regret this decision.

events.text: Shame! Disaster! You have fallen in your royal duel with [character]. [character] demands no restitution for your crimes, and holds no ill will toward your subjects. There will be no War with [rival].

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Defeated Champion

options.text: We acknowledge defeat, and offer a gift.
Victory on the battlefield is all that matters.

events.text: After a brutal and suspenseful fight, your champion falls to his [rival] opponent. The victor's companions cannot conceal their great pleasure. "Let us review the terms of your tribute." How shall we reply?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Delicious Drinks

options.text: I will share in his revels.
Seat him at the head of the table

events.text: While attending a courtly feast, you are approached by a brooding stranger in fine, colorful robes. He hands you a cup and encourages you to join him in a toast. You do not recognize the beverage, but it smells rich and delicious.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Demand for Justice

options.text: Spymaster, make this problem go away.
Putting [character] on the court will ease tensions.

events.text: [character]'s influence in the capital continues to grow unchecked. His supporters demand justice. Many see him as the rightful heir to the throne. At the very least, they believe he has a place in court. As unrest grows in [city], you are expected to act.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Demands Accepted

options.text: I never doubted it for a moment.

events.text: Begrudgingly, the [rival] court accepts our ransom demands. They call for the immediate release of [character], after which they will uphold their terms of the bargain. It seems the [family]' gamble paid off.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Demands Refused

options.text: Let [character] languish in prison.
Incorporate [character] into the royal family.
Send [character] away to be someone else's problem.

events.text: After months of tense debate and in-fighting, the [rival] court has sent a message refusing our ransom demands. The fate of the heir, [character], is not enough to coerce them into action. The plot has failed. Now what?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Diamond Jubilee

options.text: These old bones do ache so, but we shall appear before the people.
We fear not many days remain for ourselves. We will not spend them in frivolously.

events.text: This year is truly most blessed by the fates! For [character] celebrates his Diamond Jubilee, a reign of 75 years. Words cannot express our gratitude, and praise for the King's long life. The court awaits your decision, how shall we celebrate this most auspicious and monumental of days?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Diplomatic Misstep

options.text: It would be wise to boost military support.
We must heap gifts upon the [rival].

events.text: [character] does not react favorably to our order for him to cease relations with [rival]. With a grand declaration, the [tribe] form an official alliance with the [rival]. It seems our relations with the [tribe] have gone awry.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Discussions with [character]

options.text: They should all band together and make sacrifices for the common good.
They should enjoy life the best they can, especially when it is hard.

events.text: You are immersed in a conversation with [character] as you walk the streets of [city] where the wise philosopher taught you so many lessons. This time, the discussion turns towards the inevitability of the city falling onto hard times. When the citizens of [city] face difficulty, [character] asks, what do you as the ruler think they should do?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Discussions with [character]

options.text: Well-trained soldiers moving in practiced formation lead to victory.
Hitting the enemy's flanks with speed and routing them.
Wars are won by keeping them popular back home.

events.text: Now that we are at war with [rival], your tutor [character] is eager to discuss military strategy with you. [character] is a man of great wisdom and intelligence but he has never fought himself so, for once, he is the one who is learning. You know that warfare is much more complicated that you can explain in an hour or even a day, but what will you tell [character] the key to victory is?

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Dissatisfaction in [city]

options.text: They are only proving themselves both fickle and coddled.

events.text: Following the local Luxury shortage, [family] nobility in [city] have been blaming all manner of ills on royal policy, souring opinion throughout the city against your rule.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Distant Riches: A Second Expedition?

options.text: Of course!
Once was enough.

events.text: Sataspes has returned to [city] with a new proposal. He will again travel to the lands of the Saka, or perhaps even beyond them, to secure the trade of even more luxuries to [rival]. “You have seen what I can do,” he boasts, “I ask only for the opportunity to do so again! Of course, I will need funds…”

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Distant Riches: Contact

options.text: No, you’ve had enough. Do what you must.

events.text: At long last, word has reached you from the explorer, Sataspes. A message has arrived detailing his contact with a nomadic people known as the Saka, who roam a vast steppe, rarely settling in one place for long. Despite their lack of cities, they have access to many wondrous goods, some of which they produce themselves while others are traded from even more distant lands. Sataspes feels that he is on the verge of securing a supply of these luxuries for [rival], but he requests you send more funds to sweeten the deal with his contacts. Otherwise, he fears he must resort to more underhand tactics to force their hand. His messenger stands ready to convey your reply.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Distant Riches: Results!

options.text: What luxuries!

events.text: A great merchant caravan has arrived at the gates of [city] today, sent by the explorer Sataspes. They have traveled a vast distance to bring you the luxuries secured by your expedition. While the journey is still not an easy one, now that they have blazed a trail a steady trade can be maintained.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Divine Harmony

options.text: Encourage the students of different religions being taught together.
Decree that education does not require the teaching of a religion.
Ask to learn more about her theories on the divine.

events.text: You find [character] at work, surrounded by piles of parchments of mathematical treatises and various astrolabes. She gives a great sigh and starts to talk without looking up, "[character] has been asking about my lack of theurgy and ritual in my teaching, claiming a lack of piety. But such rituals will alienate my [religion] students. All I want is to seek harmony together, is that really too much to ask?"

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Dual Invitations

options.text: Go to the [family] military review.
Attend the [family] legal conference.
Refuse to indulge their pettiness.

events.text: The squabbling [family] and [family] families have each requested your presence at important events on the same day. Both must know that your absence would embarrass the other. What will you do?

events.author: Solver
events.name: E Pluribus Plures

options.text: Such talk only weakens [rival].

events.text: [rival] is a great nation, no doubt, but political squabbles can sometimes make it appear less so. Multiple prominent people in [rival] are openly questioning your leadership. Rumor has it that [character] is among the naysayers, but the individuals do not matter - what matters is that the nation is not truly united. The opposing faction is claiming that you are a purely military man, great at warfare but unable to leave a lasting legacy. They are saying that, should your rule not be best for [rival], you would no longer be deserving of full support from your people.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Education of the Rightful Heir

options.text: He will study Philosophy.
He will study Politics.
He will study Tactics.
He will study Commerce.
[character] will learn out in the world.

events.text: If [character] is to return to the throne some day, he will need a proper education. How would you like to educate [character]?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Eloped!

options.text: Let the lovers find a joyful destiny together.
Send soldiers to bring them back at once!
Claim the wedding was planned, to save face.

events.text: By the time you hear the news, the young couple has already fled the city. Overwhelmed with passion, your son [character] has eloped with his beloved. The two have a significant head start... that is if you plan to pursue them.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Eloper Captured

options.text: Pay for the release of both.
Pay for [character]’s release, but refuse [character].
They got into this mess, they can get out of it.

events.text: The message is short, but alarming. While eloping, [character] and [character] have been captured by [rival]. The [rival] are offering to return the two hostages for payment. Will you accept?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: End Times

options.text: At least my memory might live on.

events.text: Just as the fading signs of the [event] foretell its end, your body tells you that you too shall soon leave this world. Calling on [character], you pass on to your heir what you’ve learned during these calamitous times.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Enemies in Deed

options.text: The war with [rival] has gone on too long.
How could I have been so blind? Violence is never the answer.
These are different times.

events.text: As beautiful as it is, a deep melancholy seeps from the painting. As you study the detailed figures frozen in their acts of war you consider the irony of followers of the Buddha fighting. Is such violence and warfare between his followers really what the Buddha would have wanted?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Era's End

options.text: It was nice, for a time.
I am hopeful that peace may yet be restored.
It is time now to focus on internal affairs.
At last we will take what is ours.

events.text: As war breaks out with [rival], so ends an [event]. Blades are sharpened, city gates closed. Calm shifts to unease as all of [rival] awaits your reaction.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Escalated Feud

options.text: Accept the bribe.
Let [character] rot in prison for this plot.
Sigh.

events.text: The childhood feud between [character] and [character] has escalated. We have discovered that [character] is offering members of the court substantial bribes to look the other way while assassins kill [character]. What do you do?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Executed Spies

options.text: [character] is to blame for this disaster.
I take full responsibility for this disaster.

events.text: Dreadful news has arrived. The agents sent by [character] to sway the [tribe] toward a Alliance Tribe have been discovered. After a lengthy interrogation, they were executed and hung from the village gates as a warning to other intruders. The [tribe] are more wary of you now than ever before.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Expelling the Garrison

options.text: We will risk our lives to defend our freedoms.
The strong do what they can, and the weak suffer what they must.

events.text: The [tribe] garrison has brought unrest in [city] to a boiling point. Our people demand that we expel the occupiers, but doing so will surely lead to war. What shall we do?

events.author: Solver
events.name: Experienced Instructor

options.text: [character] will make a great general.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: Though [character] wants to be on the front lines, he should help train more troops.

events.text: [character] has been training soldiers personally and has acquired quite a reputation. Now he returns to you, saying that he is ready to serve as a general in our army. There is no doubt that [character] possesses exceptional tactical skills and is well-respected.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Failed Assassination

options.text: I always knew it would come to this.

events.text: Assassins have failed to kill the heir, [character], but he has already taken his revenge! Just this morning, [character] was discovered dead on his chamber floor. Poisoned. Fortunately, your role in this mess has escaped notice.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Fall from Power

options.text: This treachery will be remembered centuries after my last breath.

events.text: The conspiracy to install [character] as the heir was more far-reaching than you had imagined. [character] had enlisted the help of some guards, while [character] lured many palace officials over. Even the cattle overseer was among the plotters. As the conspirators attack, you find out that [character] will be allowed to remain on the court, but [character] will be the next ruler of [rival]. They do not kill you outright, but only because [character] needs some time to prepare for [character]'s accession. With your injuries, it will happen soon enough...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Family Council

options.text: Make an example of them all.
No council, but we will consider reforms.
Let us attempt a cooperative approach.

events.text: Ignoring the concerns of the [family] has resulted in mounting discontent among the noble Family. An envoy of Family Elders led by [character] travel to the Capital on a mission to mend relations with the crown. They would like to appoint a ruling council to reduce corruption and ease the burden of leadership.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Family Marriage Offer
events.text: A new marriage proposal from the [family] has arrived for [relative] [character]. What is our answer?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Quarrel

options.text: Let them sack and raze the city!
Take the city, but spare the civilians.
Bring [character] back to home to the [family] family.

events.text: At last! Our soldiers have breached the walls of the city! [character] and [character] are somewhere inside. What are your orders?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Quarrel

options.text: It is now or never. Assault the city!
Let us be free of [character] and [character].

events.text: [rival] forces outside the besieged city grow wearier, and violence fills the camps every night. We run the risk of a full mutiny if we do not attack soon. What are your orders?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Quarrel

options.text: Let them sack and raze the city!
Take the city, but spare the civilians.
Bring [character] back to home to the [family] family.

events.text: The distant city harboring [character] and his lover, [character], is intrigued by our wooden horse. Its garrison has brought the structure inside the city walls for inspection. The troops inside await your orders...

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Quarrel

options.text: Retreat, and abandon the cause.
Keep up the siege until they surrender.
Build a wooden horse and hide our troops inside.

events.text: After many months in pursuit, [character] has followed [character] and his lover, [character], to a city in a distant land. He has launched a siege of the city, but its defenses hold strong. He wishes us to lend support. What do we tell [character]?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Family Quarrel

options.text: Maybe if we keep the siege up just a little while longer...
Ready or not, it is time to scale the walls!
Retreat, and abandon the cause.

events.text: Our soldiers grow weary of laying siege to the impenetrable city where [character] and [character] have sought sanctuary. Morale is low, and the defenders show no signs of surrendering. What are your orders?

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Far From Home

options.text: [rival] will pay in blood. This I swear.
Surely there must be an explanation for this.
Demand reparations from [rival].

events.text: It seemed a profitable arrangement, closer ties to [rival] and more coin for the coffers. Your son, [character], was to be married off to the [rival] royal line in exchange for diplomatic favor and a generous dowry. Tragically, [character] was killed on his way to [rival]. You curse the incompetence of the court and their inability to provide clear details on what happened, but it seems that [character] died well within [rival] borders.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Final Confession

options.text: Give a detailed list of every misdeed and wayward thought.
Seek repentance for your greatest sin.
Refuse to divulge your past mistakes.

events.text: As you lie on your bed, weakened by, you are visited by a somber procession of family, well-wishers and state dignitaries. Of the last is, who stays behind after the others have cleared the room. Gently, he asks if you wish to share any past sins to seek Redemption in the eyes of.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Fires and Altars

options.text: The gods are in all things, buildings do not change that.
Order the construction of new open air altars.

events.text: Visitors to [rival] have spread stories across the world about the people who worship fire, but such tales are not true. It is the divinity of Atar that the fire represents that is central to the rituals of [religion]. But the fire of [city] has been fading. Some of the priests claim that such disfavor is due to the gods being insulted by the construction of shrines as no god could, or should, be constrained to a human building.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: First Strike

options.text: If [character] thinks he can win this war, I might as well see how it unfolds.
...He did what? I will see to it that's the last order he will be giving my soldiers.

events.text: [character] has launched a preemptive strike against the [tribe]. The raid executed perfectly, causing mayhem and destruction with virtually no [rival] losses. Of course, [city] was only informed of the raid after the fact, and retaliatory [tribe] warbands are no doubt already massing.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Flocks of Rage

options.text: Bother.

events.text: The palace has been blissfully quiet since the release of your pet bird. The streets are not so peaceful. As it turns out, birds can also learn phrases from each other, and your unsavory insults for your one-time pet are echoing around the streets of [city].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: For Your Faith

options.text: We welcome their blades.
The time for fighting is over.

events.text: The messengers from [character] thunder into the hall. "[rival] stands ready and able if you will still accept our weapons. As an apology for the delay, [title] [character] has sent two of our forces of chariots for you to command." Their religious practices over, shall [rival] join the fight against [rival]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Forest Fire

options.text: The citizens of [city] are grateful that you tried.

events.text: The fires outside [city] left nothing in their terrible wake. The whole forest was reduced to ashes.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Forest Fire

rewards.text: Build Ancient Tomb on the tile

options.text: Preserve the tomb's original grandeur.

rewards.text: Build National Monument on the tile

options.text: Declare the tomb a national monument.
We cannot afford it right now.

events.text: Scholars and elders have come forward to request that we spare the ancient tomb uncovered in [city]. They have asked for the site to be preserved for its cultural significance.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Forest Fire

options.text: Fund her training and then bring her to court.
Offer her the position of scribe in [city].
I will adopt her into my royal family.

events.text: Some homes outside [city] were destroyed in the recent forest fires, and there are reports of deaths. One survivor, a young girl named [character], lost her whole family and has been given sanctuary by the local government. Apparently, [character] shows impressive strength of character. Perhaps she could be of use to us.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Forest Fire

options.text: Search the tomb for valuable treasures.

rewards.text: Build Ancient Tomb on the tile

options.text: Preserve the tomb's original grandeur.
Consult the locals as to what they wish to see done with this tomb.

events.text: In the wake of the [city] fires, salvage efforts discover an ancient burial site. Fires burned away years of overgrowth to expose the tomb entrance. What shall the salvagers do?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Forest Fire

options.text: This is good news.

events.text: Salvage crews have managed to rescue large amounts of wood from the recent fires near [city].

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Found Wanting

options.text: We must expunge this corruption!
Charge [character] with correcting this course.
My predecessors had the right idea.

events.text: The accounts of [city] have always been perfect, exceeding expectations and brimming with gold. However, after one of your officials became suspicious of the amount of grain they had been sold, an investigation has revealed that the city is using a system of Adjusted Weights. Who knows how long this corruption has been taking root.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Fraying Edge

options.text: Unfortunate.
Betrayal is betrayal. End the husband, evict the husband.
Perhaps I pushed too far.

events.text: A nervous looking servant from the household of [character] conveys a short missive. "My [title], do not judge me too harshly, but the gods have not given me strength enough for life here with [character]. I cannot remain, but by way of apology, I leave half my modest savings to the crown, and the rest to [character], may it bring him some solace."

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: From Grand Vizier to Uncrowned King

options.text: Such betrayal cannot be forgiven.

events.text: [character] is through with waiting, through with appointments, and through with politics. If he is barred from the halls of power, why not storm them and take the throne itself?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Fruitful Affair

options.text: This is a blessing to us all.

events.text: Nine months ago, the morning after a great royal feast, you woke up next to one of your minor courtiers. The affair was short... but fruitful. Your new child cannot inherit the throne, but it will surely be a blessing to your household.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Furious Emissary

options.text: Return the child, and order [character] to commit suicide.
Return the child, and apologize for the misunderstanding.
Refuse to give up a perfectly good hostage.

events.text: A frantic emissary arrives from the [tribe]. He accuses [character] of kidnapping their infant heir to secure the peace. How will we respond to this accusation?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Golden Jubilee

options.text: Prepare a procession, offerings to the gods, and festivities for our people.
We shall not be paraded about the capital like a prize-winning horse.

events.text: This year is a most remarkable year in the chronicles of the royal family of [rival]. [character] celebrates to his Golden Jubilee, a reign of 50 years. The court awaits your decision, how shall we celebrate this most rare and treasured of days?

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Grove, Spouse, and Prophet

options.text: Throw this raving lunatic from the kingdom!
It wasn't my idea!
I cannot be married to a murderer.

events.text: While attending a festival, [character] is found guilty of high crimes and stoned to death by a mob. [character] comes to you splattered in the blood of [character] and hands you a property deed. He kisses you breathlessly. "The grove is now yours, my dear." [character] rushes in and stares wild-eyed at the dogs licking the blood of [character] from the cobbles. "Have you murdered this man and taken possession of his grove? Behold! God shall bring evil upon you and [character] shall be eaten by dogs!" How shall we respond?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Guiding Council

options.text: We must value honesty and knowledge.
Heredity is the main qualification.
Hire one whose weakness you can exploit.
Experience is the most important qualification.
None of these are right.

events.text: A life of learning is never finished. The Council of [rival] help to guide you, be it through gentle advice or heated debate. The seat of the Ambassador lies empty, yet who should fill the role? The various sages and scholars of your court have differing opinions on what method should be used to select a new minister, which they share freely and at great length.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Guiding Council

options.text: We must value honesty and knowledge.
Heredity is the main qualification.
Hire one whose weakness you can exploit.
Experience is the most important qualification.
None of these are right.

events.text: A life of learning is never finished. The Council of [rival] help to guide you, be it through gentle advice or heated debate. The seat of the Chancellor lies empty, yet who should fill the role? The various sages and scholars of your court have differing opinions on what method should be used to select a new minister, which they share freely and at great length.
