events.name: Guiding Council

options.text: We must value honesty and knowledge.
Heredity is the main qualification.
Hire one whose weakness you can exploit.
Experience is the most important qualification.
None of these are right.

events.text: A life of learning is never finished. The Council of [rival] help to guide you, be it through gentle advice or heated debate. The seat of the Spymaster lies empty, yet who should fill the role? The various sages and scholars of your court have differing opinions on what method should be used to select a new minister, which they share freely and at great length.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Hand of [rival]

options.text: Return [character] authority.
Expect [rival] military actions.

events.text: [character] response is swift and unequivocal. "Grant [character] all due authority, or expect actions from the [rival] military to enforce that authority. There will be no further warning."

events.author: Solver
events.name: Harem Conspiracy Crushed

options.text: Imprison [character] as well. He is a threat to me.
There is not a shred of evidence against [character]. We cannot imprison people on a mere suspicion.

events.text: The royal guard succeeded in dealing with the conspirators! Despite the supporters [character] had recruited for the plan, the guards seized him and your husband [character] as well. Unfortunately, [character], the mastermind of the plot, managed to seize a dagger from one of the guards and plunged it into his own heart, so he will never face justice. [character] and the low-ranking plotters are already in prison. The question remains of what to do with [character], whom the plotters wanted to install as heir. [character] swears he never knew about the plot, and [character] confirms that, but [character], the heir, does not believe [character]'s assurances.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Heir Education

options.text: He will study Philosophy.
He will study Politics.
He will study Tactics.
He will study Commerce.
[character] will learn out in the world.

events.text: Time passes quickly. [character] is growing up fast and eager to learn. How would you like to educate [character]?

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Heir Education

options.text: He will study Philosophy.
He will study Politics.
He will study Tactics.
He will study Commerce.

events.text: Time passes quickly. [character] is growing up fast and eager to learn. How would you like to educate [character]?

events.author: Leyla Johnson/Jeri Roys
events.name: Heir Education
events.text: Time passes quickly. [character] is growing up fast and eager to learn. How would you like to educate [character]?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Hindu Dissent

options.text: Prepare the guards for any unrest.
Seek to appease the local [religion] leaders.
Take no action, for now.

events.text: [religion] discontent has spilled onto the streets of [city]. Unhappy with your rule, the local are leading the faithful in attacks on the guards and encouraging resistance against the crown.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Home Safe

options.text: We must be more careful whom we trust.
Improve palace security to prevent future incidents.

events.text: Fortune favors [rival] on this day! The heir to the throne, [character], has been rescued from the clutches of the [rival]. Despite the harrowing ordeal, he seems unharmed. A sigh of relief is heard across the nation...

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Hostile Neighbors

options.text: Pay the tribute in gold.
Pay the tribute in iron.
Pay the tribute in food.
Refuse to pay any tribute.

events.text: A procession of ambassadors and soldiers from [rival] enters the capital. Their leader, a bearded, bejeweled diplomat, addresses the court. "[character] has so far shown patience with your insolence, but now you will pay the tribute owed to our nation. Show your fealty, or suffer the consequences." What is our response?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Hostile Neighbors

options.text: Pay the tribute in gold.
Pay the tribute in iron.
Pay the tribute in food.
Refuse to pay any tribute.

events.text: [rival] military officer and his squad of soldiers march into court, causing great alarm. He reads from a crisp, sealed scroll. "Your next tribute payment is due. We will make ourselves comfortable until the matter is settled." How shall we respond to this intimidation?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Hostile Neighbors

options.text: We agree to a limited trade deal.
Politely decline.

events.text: [rival] diplomat requests an audience, saying that she speaks for [character]. "Our mighty ruler appreciates your cooperation in paying the tribute owed to our nation. Now that our relationship has been established, he desires to sample your goods." She bows before the court. "Will you agree to trade with us?"

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Hostile Neighbors

options.text: Bring us [rival]'s best officers!
Increase training and raise militias!

events.text: Chaos erupts in court! Generals issue orders, as messengers rush to their mounts. A declaration of war has arrived from [rival], and the whole nation prepares for a conflict. What are our orders?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Immoral Gods

options.text: [character] is right, we must uphold the ideals of moral gods.
He is doing the gods a disservice by not accepting their deeds.

events.text: The gods of [rival] are no role models. Often petty, unfaithful and vengeful, the stories of [religion] emphasize their shocking humanity. [character] has taken to writing about the morality, or lack of, of the gods, claiming that the gods are perfect beings and so such stories must be corrupting falsehoods. The dialogs about the role of the gods and the nature of right and wrong have been spreading through the court.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Immunity

options.text: [character] is above common punishment.
Publicly rebuke him for his rash actions.

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: He will be punished for his crimes and banished.
Death is the price of murder.

events.text: A drunken dispute leads to brutal murder! The [rival] court agent, [character] stands accused of stabbing another man over the affections of a woman. Witnesses place him at the scene of the crime, bloody dagger in hand. "Please," [character] pleads, "it was a mistake. I was caught in the throes of madness. I am a guest here. Grant me immunity for this crime!"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: In Defense of the Holy City

options.text: Join the war to help [city].
Open your borders to refugees from the fighting.
Refuse your help.

events.text: News quickly spreads across [rival] that the [religion] Holy City of [city] is under attack. The night skies fill with the glow of fires as the [religion] leaders guide their gathered followers in <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_ZOROASTRIANISM>sacrifices<p=SUBJECT_RELIGION_PAGAN>sacrifices<else>prayers<end> for the safety of the holy city. [character] makes an impassioned plea before the court, asking for [rival]'s aid defending the holy city in this time of need.

events.author: Jeri Roys
conditions: Player Fling With Spouse Of Leader
events.name: In the Name of Love

options.text: May fortune favor you, my love.
I never meant for it to go this far.

events.text: The days have flown by as you and [character] exchange discreet and affectionate messages after your encounter that now feels like a lifetime ago. One summer, a message arrives in an excited tone. "I cannot bear it any more with that churlish [character]! I have a plan for when he is next on a hunt, and all I need are a few soldiers I can trust. My mind already races with plans for a 'diplomatic' visit to [rival] after!"

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Incident at [city]

options.text: Loudly proclaim that [character] was in the right.
Rebuke [character] for causing a scene.
Encourage the two to make amends.
Use the story of [character] conversion to support his argument.

events.text: As [religion] spreads, there is an ongoing debate over the path of the new religion, which doctrines it should keep from its roots and which should be left behind. The councils where these matters are discussed are not always calm meetings, especially when [character] is involved. [character] has engaged in a heated public debate with [character] at a council in [city], accusing the [title] of hypocrisy in demanding that the other [religion] follow customs that he himself does not. As rumors of the argument between these two leaders within the church spreads, there is no clear consensus on the outcome. But upon returning to the capital, [character] is keen to hear your opinion.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Incriminating Messages

options.text: Remove [character], and the [family] will fall.
Expose the family and win over [character].

events.text: Your accusations of plotting cause a sensation! However, the claims appear to be true. After a short investigation, royal agents have uncovered a series of incriminating messages between [character] and the [family] family. Their political alliance was more than it appeared. Only you and your closest advisors possess this sensitive information. Now, what will you do with it?

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Infanticide

options.text: A life for a life.
Jail for [character]!
Banish [character].

events.text: Terrible news greets you today, [character] has murdered [character], the son of [character], in a jealous rage! You must decide what to do with him.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Infidelity

options.text: The letter is a fabrication, and I trust [character].
Lock them both where I cannot see them.

events.text: Your spouse and his "companion" are the talk of the court. We have secured a letter written by the [title] that confesses his eternal love to this person. It is quite damning. How shall we proceed?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Investigation Complete

options.text: Leave [character] alone and see what happens.
Imprison him. I will take no chances.

events.text: Our Spymaster has discovered valuable information about [character], the stranger claiming to share your royal blood. He is an honest man after all. His claims to the throne are valid... but the proof could be easily destroyed.

options.text: n/a
n/a

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Jewish Dissent

options.text: Prepare the guards for any unrest.
Seek to appease the local [religion] leaders.
Take no action, for now.

events.text: [religion] discontent has spilled onto the streets of [city], Unhappy with your rule, the local are leading the faithful in attacks on the guards and encouraging resistance against the crown.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Just in Time

options.text: The city guard deserves praise. In the future, they should be even more capable.
Celebrate this as a success of local governance.
My foresight is to be credited for the killer's capture.

events.text: Good and most welcome news comes from [city]. The city guard has been on high alert, looking for a killer in the city. Last night, they tried to stop a man who was muttering to himself in the streets, only for the man to put up unexpectedly violent resistance. The guards overpowered the man, who was carrying a knife and, in his own words, looking for someone to send to the afterlife. He said that - he said a lot of other things, too. The chief of the guard in [city] claims it took three hours for the man to stop talking after he was detained. Tonight, the citizens of [city] will sleep soundly, but they will surely remember these events for a long time yet.

events.author: Brodie Frehlich
events.name: Keeper of the Forest

options.text: Hire more workers to thin the forest near [city].
[character] can deal with this himself.
Work with [character] to establish Reforestation Efforts in [city].

events.text: Ever watchful of the woods around [city], [character] notices that the forest has grown tinder dry of late. Lichen hangs like torn parchment from sapless branches while brittle needles line the forest floor. It’s only a matter of time before a [event] sets the woods ablaze.

events.author: Solver
events.name: Killer loose in [city]

options.text: Send whatever help [city] needs.
Summon the best healers to help [character] recover quickly.
Focus on reassuring the [family] and [family].

events.text: The city of [city] was still discussing the deaths in its baths when another shocking event happened. Governor [character] was attacked at dusk by a strange man. [character] suffered some injuries but managed to fight off the attacker, who then fled the scene. The governor says the man looked deranged and was screaming about "[family] tyrants" and "[family] swine" among other incoherencies. All of [city] is now searching for the man, who is surely behind the killings in the baths as well.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Knives of the Conspiracy

options.text: Conspiracies are real.

events.text: You awaken to a band of assassins swarming your chambers. Your royal guards lie dead on the floor. As one assassin draws his dagger, he whispers, "[character] sends his regards."

options.text: n/a
n/a
n/a
n/a

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Leader of the Faith

options.text: Embrace him warmly as an equal.
Act as befits your station, inviting him to return but keeping distant.
Refuse to treat with this visitor.

events.text: There is much talk in your court of the visitor [character]. He introduces himself as the leader of [religion] and stresses that although he is not of your nation, it will be best for both of you to work together closely for the benefit of your State Religion.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Lethal Affliction

options.text: We will not let this incident prey on our fears.
Send messengers to [rival], demanding justice.
[rival] will repay our losses with its blood.

events.text: Some weeks ago, our scouts ate food offered to them by [rival] travelers. Shortly afterwards, they began to suffer from a series of seemingly unrelated illnesses, and now they have started succumbing to the lethal affliction. The food was laced with poison! Was this a cruel prank, an act of political aggression, or even a plot against you, the [title]? We may never know.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Local Brigands

options.text: Our [unit] unit deserves recognition.

events.text: In a piece of good news, the formation of [unit] we sent to protect the roads has claimed victory. In a heated battle, they killed most of the bandits and chased any survivors into the wilderness. The threat to travelers and merchants is over!

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Local Brigands

options.text: The recovered supplies will be put to good use.

events.text: In a piece of good news, the formation of [unit] we sent to protect the roads has claimed victory. In a heated battle, they killed most of the bandits and chased any survivors into the wilderness. They also recovered a cache of stolen goods.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Local Brigands

options.text: Spend what is needed to send in more forces.
Our forces in the area can handle the threat.

events.text: In a piece of surprising news, the formation of [unit] we sent to protect the roads has encountered fierce resistance. Bandit activity in the area proves to be much more widespread than we had anticipated. In fact, one might call this a rebellion.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Local Nuisance

options.text: Well, he always wanted an unceremonious life.

events.text: The citizens of [city] have had enough of [character]'s antics. The naked parades through the streets. The debates with rats. The public shaming of city elders. His cynicism has driven the public against him. On a moonless night, a band of local brigands abducts [character] from his washtub and sells him to pirates heading east to the sea.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Love Birds Rumors

options.text: People should mind their business.
Put an end to these encounters.

events.text: Upon your request, we looked into the rumors about your spouse, [character], and the time he spends with a fetching courtier. While we do not have concrete evidence of unfaithfulness, their encounters are beginning to damage your reputation. What do you command?

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Love Triangle

options.text: I will stop everything with [character].
[character] will be my new queen.
Marriage is a hindrance.

events.text: Your husband, [character], has discovered your affair with the charming envoy [character]. He demands that you end the relationship at once, or suffer his scorn until the end of your days.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Machinations

options.text: Launch an Infiltrate Mission into [rival] lands.
Weave a web of lies and slander about the [rival].
This is not the time.

events.text: The Spymaster, [character], beckons you close, whispering into your ear. He has spent many early-morning hours plotting ways to destabilize our rivals, the [rival]. All his machinations have resulted in several operations ready to strike [rival] at its weakest points. He is eager for your approval.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Making Connections

options.text: Organize an exchange of scientific and civic ideas.
Refuse to make a deal.

events.text: An emissary arrives from [rival]. "We are prepared to arrange a research agreement with the leadership of [rival]. What sort of deal are you proposing?"

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Making Peace

options.text: Treason must be punished with death.
He will spend time in prison and be released.
Agree to his terms for military reform.

events.text: [character] is brought before you, ragged and wounded. He makes no apologies for his mutiny, demanding that he and his soldiers deserve better treatment and higher pay. "Why would anyone fight for [rival] under such conditions?" With the eyes of the nation upon us, we must choose [character]'s fate.

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Man of the People

options.text: [character] is a worthy leader and will stay in power.
The people have spoken, and they have chosen the washtub philosopher.

events.text: [city] has thrived in the years since [character]'s arrival in the city. In fact, his faction has grown so large that it plans to install [character] at the head of the local government. They seem to not care that the city has a governor, [character]. Eccentricities aside, [character] has been good for [city], but it is the King's decision who rules the city.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Mani in Exile

options.text: Welcome [character] into your court.
Refuse to allow him entry.
Imprison the wandering prophet and return him to [rival].

events.text: [character] is no longer welcome in the [rival] court. Their leader [character] has been leading harsh persecutions against the [religion], driving them from their homes and denying their faith. Exiled from [rival], [character] has come to you for aid. Will you shelter this religious exile?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Manichaean Dissent

options.text: Prepare the guards for any unrest.
Seek to appease the local [religion] leaders.
Take no action, for now.

events.text: [religion] discontent has spilled onto the streets of [city], Unhappy with your rule, the local are leading the faithful in attacks on the guards and encouraging resistance against the crown.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Mercenary Demands

options.text: Very well, I will meet their demands.
I will not be coerced!

events.text: Captains of the [unit] Mercenary you are leading meet you in the field. They are decidedly unhappy, but enter your tent on your insistence and exchange worried and concerned glances between themselves. You offer them refreshments. They refuse, and demand more pay. Tensions rise, as the Mercenary eye their weapons nervously.

events.author: Jeri Roys
events.name: Meritocracy

options.text: I don't care who is going to object. This must end.
He is so sure of himself. Let's see how he likes real responsibility.

events.text: Infuriating, is the only word for it. Every piece of advice [character] gives, if you follow it, he gets the credit, while if you ignore it, you get the blame. You are at the end of your tether, and something must give.

events.author: Zorbaz
events.name: Miracle Birth

options.text: Throw a feast! The world shall remember this day!
Prepare thanksgiving offerings to the gods!
Even the gods themselves cannot stop us!

events.text: This is a joyous day! Your marriage to [character] was thought to be barren, but the gods have shown favor by providing an heir in your old age.

events.author: David Ballantyne
events.name: Monkey Medicine: Consequences

options.text: The paw is a curse!

events.text: This morning your son, [character], did not wake up. No sign of injury or illness can be found, but his face is locked in an expression of terror and his <p.is_sub.S1=SUBJECT_BABY>tiny<p=SUBJECT_TODDLER>tiny<p=SUBJECT_CHILD>little<else>clenched<end> hands are curled up in the same shape as your monkey paw...

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Monkey See, Monkey Kill

options.text: I am tired of managing this monkey.
Who are we to deny him his destiny?

events.text: Your adorable monkey assassin seems discontent with stalking the ruling court of [rival]. Perhaps he wishes to see the world, meet interesting world leaders... and murder them. After all, what is the point of having a monkey assassin if you never use him?

events.author: Solver
events.name: More Victims

options.text: Reinforce the guard to reassure the people.
Dispatch soldiers as bodyguards to the nobles until this is over.
I will give a speech in [city] to rally the people.
I can only hope this ends soon.

events.text: Many precautions were taken in [city] while looking for the bathhouse killer. The [family] and [family] nobles have been particularly careful, but almost everyone in the city has had the murders on their mind. Still, the precautions turns out to be insufficient. A patrol finds another two people dead in the streets of [city], commoners this time. The nobles may be somewhat relieved that they're not being targeted, but nobody is at ease in the city now. A killer has claimed two more lives despite the many guard patrols, and all hopes are now on the guard redoubling their efforts.

events.author: Leyla Johnson
events.name: Murder Discovered

options.text: This is an understandable reaction.

events.text: The [family] family has discovered that you were behind the assassination of your wife [character]. They are furious!

events.author: Andy Auseon
events.name: Mystery Solved

options.text: Declare war on [rival] to retrieve the heir.
We are in no position to fight [rival].

events.text: Our agents on the trail of [character] and the kidnapped [character] have reached the border of [rival]. It seems that the [rival] court approved of your heir's abduction, though they now deny any involvement. Calls for war fill the air of the capital. You must act soon if there is to be a chance of saving [character].

events.author: Solver
events.name: National Exploration?

options.text: Exploring the world shall be a national priority.
As I pursue my own desires, I must recognize it may not be in the people's best interest.

events.text: Recent social developments have granted you the ability to declare Exploration as a priority for all of [rival]. It has long been your personal ambition and now you must decide whether what is best for you is also best for [rival] and its people.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Welcome all [rival] to [rival].
Send gifts as a display of goodwill.
Refuse to treat with them.

events.text: Weary riders enter the capital with a message: the ruler of [rival] wishes you warm greetings and would like to establish friendly relations. We know little of these [rival]. How shall we proceed?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Invest in this rare opportunity.
We cannot afford his proposal.

events.text: A merchant adorned in fine robes and silver jewelry arrives from [city]. He claims that he is an influential figure in [rival] and can arrange a lasting peace with [character]... for a price. He awaits our reply.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: This is an unfortunate misunderstanding.
Wait, wait, let me explain...

events.text: An emissary from [rival] arrives, desiring a relationship with us. Upon learning that we gave a large sum of gold to someone else claiming to represent Carthage, he laughs and calls us fools. "Our people would never put a trade partner into such a compromised position." How shall we respond?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We look forward to improved relations.
May this gift express our deep shame.

events.text: An emissary from [rival] arrives, desiring a relationship with us. Upon learning that we met with an agent claiming to be from Carthage, he grows suspicious. "This other man was an impostor. You did well to act cautiously, but we are insulted that you believed we might extort you for peace. Our peoples will need to learn more about each other before we enter into any deals."

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Donate to the Temple of Osiris.
Refuse the diplomats' help.

events.text: A huddle of diplomats arrives from [rival]. Their leader steps before the court and makes a dire declaration: "Set has cast a shadow over your people, and he is a ruthless god. We can beseech the god Osiris, who is Set's brother, to grant you favor and erase the shadow." Shall we seek their help?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Donate to the Temple of Isis.
We cannot afford additional donations.

events.text: The [rival] diplomats return. "Our priests welcomed your donation. They perform rituals on your behalf, yet the shadow of Set remains. Set also has a sister, the goddess Isis, who may be persuaded to assist Osiris in lifting this shadow." Shall we continue to donate?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Donate to the Temple of Ra.
Our support for Egypt cannot be sustained.

events.text: The [rival] diplomats return once again. Their leader appears pleased. "The shadow of Set has been lifted! Praise be to Osiris and Isis. Set was denied his sport of reducing your cities to rubble. Unfortunately, now the great god Ra is displeased with you." Do we continue to fund their temples?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We will defend ourselves from all enemies.
Execute the diplomats from [rival].

events.text: One last time, the [rival] diplomats return. Their leader glowers. "You refused to make donations to the gods of Egypt, who wished only to restrain their evil brother, Set. Now you will learn the extent of Set's lust for blood as he rains destruction upon your cities." How shall we respond to this threat?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We will do all we can to help [rival].
Shipments of food will be sent.
[rival] has troubles of its own.

events.text: A messenger from [rival] staggers into court, suffering from illness and starvation. He accounts the tragic misfortunes suffered by his people, and he begs for our assistance. However, some in the court worry that his claims cannot be confirmed, and that his tale of woe may be a liar's gambit. What shall we tell him?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We accept a peace with [rival].
Politely decline.

events.text: [character] of [rival] has sent us a message expressing appreciation for the food sent in their time of need. He expresses a desire to make peace with us and strengthen our growing friendship. How shall we reply?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Accept peace, and send gifts to [rival].
Accept peace, and sell goods to [rival].
Refuse peace, but sell goods to [rival].

events.text: [rival] soldier arrives on horseback, bearing an official offer of peace from [character]. The scroll is read aloud in court: "Your nation is developing a reputation for wealth and generosity. Our people desire to sample your goods." How shall we respond to [character]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We can afford to help an ally.
Friends do not exploit each other.

events.text: Rumors of hardship and tragedy in [rival] reach the court. Days later, an envoy arrives to confirm them. "Our people stand at the precipice of doom," he wails. "We ask for your help in exchange for our undying gratitude and friendship." Will we continue to support [rival]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Politely, explain that we are too busy.
Grant her request for a tour.
Personally guide her tour. Use the royal carriage.

events.text: Amid much fanfare, a member of the [rival] Senate arrives at court. She requests a tour of the capital, complete with servants and armed escorts. What shall we tell her?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Politely decline.
Accept the terms of the trade deal.
Accept the proposed peace.
Accept both peace and a trade deal.

events.text: Messengers from [rival] arrive at court, bearing an offer of peace. They wish to establish a strong trade relationship with [rival] as soon as possible. Are we ready for a partnership with [rival]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Forge an alliance with [rival].
Politely Decline.

events.text: Diplomats from [rival] arrive in court with a royal decree. Their people seek to become our political allies, entwining the fates of our two great civilizations. The visiting [rival] wait expectantly with gifts in hand. What will be our answer?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Allow trading to commence in [city].
Apologize. Next time, we will act the gracious host.

events.text: After we declined her request for a tour, the visiting senator from [rival] made her own way through the capital. During this trip, some of your local merchants agreed to trade with the [rival]. This is good for the city, but your inhospitality will be remembered. How shall we greet this development?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Politely Decline.
Agree to supply iron.
Agree to supply wood.
Agree to supply food.
Agree to supply gold.

events.text: The senator from [rival] returns, seeking aid this time. "We face a serious threat from the bloodthirsty [tribe]. I greatly appreciated your attention and kindness on my previous visit. Will you help supply our soldiers in the coming conflict?" How shall we respond?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Gold from our royal treasury.
Food for the weak and the hungry.
Sadly, we can spare nothing for [rival].

events.text: An emissary from [rival] comes before the court. His robes are torn and shabby, and he glances around anxiously as he makes a plea. "These are troubled times. If our people were experiencing hardship, would you be there to aid us?" What commitments shall we make to [rival]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Let us be lasting friends.
We wish to learn more about you first.

events.text: An ambassador from [rival] comes before the court. "Our people appreciate the beauty of life," he says, gesturing at the grand views around him. "But beauty never lasts. We [rival] are interested in what endures. Peace. Friendship. Trust. " Do we commit to peace with [rival]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: I will personally practice its wisdom.
Our best scholars will study its teachings.

events.text: [character] sends a message. He appreciates that you respect the Code of Hammurabi, which is of great significance to his people. Along with a desire for peace, [character] wishes to know how you will continue to study their important artifact. What shall we tell him?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Study the Code of Hammurabi, and offer a gift.
Study the Code of Hammurabi, and request Peace.
Offer a gift of food in thanks.
Let the ambassador return home empty handed.

events.text: The ambassador from [rival] arrives with a gift: a marble obelisk inscribed with the Code of Hammurabi. "These are our laws. Know them, and you know us. I return to Babylon three days hence. If you wish me to carry home a message or a gift, you have until then to arrange for it." What shall we do?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Welcome them with open arms.
See them when it is convenient.
Unsolicited visitors will not be heard.

events.text: Diplomats from [rival] seek the court's recognition. They claim that their ruler respects [rival] and humbly wishes to establish relations. How shall we respond?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Pledge tribute to [rival].
Vow to never pay them.
Execute the [rival] fools.

events.text: Emissaries arrive from [rival], bringing with them an air of menace. In a pompous speech, they declare that weak nations should know their place in the natural order. "Tribute must be given, or a demonstration of your weakness may become necessary." They turn to you for a response.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We have no choice but to give tribute.

tip: As leader: +10% Unit Trait Modifier / Tribal
As general: +25% Unit Trait Modifier / Tribal

options.text: [rival] does not pay for peace.

events.text: Stern [rival] emissaries arrive with a statement for the court: "It is time. Are you ready to prove your nation's worth on the field of battle, or will you pay?" How shall we answer?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: What if we offer tribute in silver?
We will gladly pay to avoid a conflict.
Your false god will fall before us.

events.text: A hulking [rival] envoy and his martial retinue arrive at court. He declares that Ares, the Greek god of war, has offered a divine treasure to the Greek warrior who slays the most [rival] in battle. Will we tolerate such insults?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Our people can use the food.
Politely decline.

events.text: Enterprising traders from [rival] find themselves with a grain surplus, and they are eager to do business. They wish to provide food in exchange for our fine lumber. Shall we agree to this trade?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Accept Persia's gift of Gold and agree to Peace.
Politely decline.

events.text: [character] sends a delegation bearing lavish gifts. The servants read his message, "[character], please accept this gift of friendship and secure a peace between our nations."

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Send our finest minds to attend.

rewards.text: Begin project: Annual Feast for Persian Guests

options.text: Counterpropose an annual feast in [city].
Send only those who can pay their own way.

events.text: [character] admires the capability of our artisans and holy men. Persia wishes to host a feast, which our finest minds are invited to attend.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Executions will send a message.
Release them, but with a grave warning.
Let them go without condition.

events.text: [rival] spies have been captured infiltrating our territory. They were sent to gather information about our nation, but we do not know why. It is troubling. We must send a strong message to [rival].

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Accept Peace with [rival].
Politely decline.

events.text: A royal emissary arrives from [rival] with a message of friendship. "Your people tend to be secretive, which led us to distrust you. However, the mercy that you showed our spies, has reassured us." It seems that [rival] desires peace. How shall we reply?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Trade for lumber.
Trade for limestone.
Trade for iron ore.

events.text: Merchants from [rival] arrive in [city], offering to trade us materials in exchange for works of art produced by our potters, painters, and sculptors.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We will accept peace with a token of goodwill.
Osiris has our respect, and [rival] has our friendship.
Now is not the time for peace.

events.text: Visiting dignitaries from [rival] would like to establish peace with us. They say our humility and kindness pleases the Egyptian god Osiris. What shall we tell them?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Begin forming the alliance with [rival].
Continue trade, but refuse formal ties.

events.text: Your friendly neighbors from [rival] have sent a message: "Your respect for Osiris, the Egyptian god, has pleased [character]. He desires an alliance." How shall we proceed?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Fund the transition to peace with [rival].
Decline peace, but sell art to [character].

events.text: Your agents report that [character] has become an admirer of [rival] works of art. He seeks closer relations with us, wishing to acquire more pieces for his collection. Shall we indulge [character]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Continue trade, but decline official peace.
We welcome peace and trade.
Guests should not insult their hosts.

events.text: "[character] is a wise leader," declares a messenger from [rival]. "He has watched your behavior with interest and finds you worthy of his attention. A trade partnership would benefit your struggling nation." How shall we respond?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Charge a fee to establish an embassy.
Suggest a tribute as an act of respect.
Agree to relations, but mention the might of our armies.

events.text: A contingent from distant [rival] arrives in the capital, banners flapping. As they enter the court, they bow respectfully, requesting the honor of establishing relations with [rival]. How shall we respond?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We accept peace with the [rival].

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

options.text: They dare to think themselves our equal?

events.text: [rival] sends a familiar emissary to deliver a stern message. He stands before you, raises his fists, and slams them together. "Two nations as bold as ours should unite against our mutual enemies. The strong will prey on the weak." Do we accept a treaty with [rival]?

events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We accept peace with the [rival].

As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

events.name: Neighbors

options.text: We accept peace with the [rival].

tip: As leader: +50 Unit Trait XP / Infantry
As governor: +100 Unit Trait XP / Infantry

events.text: [rival] sends a familiar emissary to deliver a stern message. He stands before you, raises his fists, and slams them together. "Two nations as bold as ours should unite against our mutual enemies. The strong will prey on the weak." Do we accept a treaty with [rival]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Pay [rival] their restraint fee.
Return the diplomat to [rival]... as a corpse.
Refill his cup, praise his boldness, and offer him a trade deal.

events.text: A large, laughing diplomat from [rival] arrives, and he throws a great feast in honor of his hosts. Wine flows. Conversation fills the hall. Tongue loosened, the diplomat speaks frankly. "We understand that your nation is fond of speaking boldly and imposing fees on its neighbors. That is well and good. But we now require you to pay us. It is a restraint fee, for not burning down your cities and salting the earth beneath the rubble." How will we respond to his request?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Is this how you see [rival]? Unacceptable!
Begone before you put us to sleep.
Let us pay you for your time and effort.

events.text: A scholarly diplomat arrives from [rival] with a wagon full of clay tablets. Selecting a particular document, he begins to read, boasting of the achievements of his people. The list seems endless, and the claims are increasingly ridiculous. We must stop this performance, but what shall we say?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Accept peace, and initiate a trade deal.
Accept peace, and trade grains and crops.
Accept peace, and trade metals and ores.
Accept peace, and require a personal cut of every deal.

events.text: The prominent emissary from [rival] returns to court. "My ruler, [character], listened to stories of my last visit with interest. We are awed by your achievements. Perhaps your great wealth could be spent purchasing some of our fine [rival] goods?" Shall we explore trade with [rival]?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Accept peace, and initiate a trade deal.
Accept peace, and discuss trading seafood and dyes.
Accept peace, and discuss trading livestock.
Threaten to declare war unless paid a huge sum.

events.text: [rival] emissary seeks an audience. He carries himself with the air of a skilled merchant. "You are wise to extract every possible coin from us," he explains, "as we will do the same with you. We understand each other well. Let us agree to peace and engage in high level trade talks." What shall we do?

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Accept their Tribute.

events.text: An emissary arrives from [rival], appearing before you with an manner of humility and respect. He informs you that the great nation has agreed to pay you tribute.

events.author: Bob Thomas
events.name: Neighbors

options.text: Peace is the path of the wise.
Politely decline.
Now is not the time, but perhaps later...

events.text: A diplomat arrives from faraway [rival]. He toasts the court with a cup of fine wine. "Now that our two peoples have established relations, [character] wishes to know if you would be interested in a formal peace." How shall we reply?
